verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a self-hostable feature-flag server, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The nearest items are adjacent and earn no credit: Edge keeps targeting PII local, and external impact metrics stay in the user's own Prometheus.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
